bio: Research Overview Research Background Education Publications Contact Us Dr. Agus is engaged in clinical research activities that attempt to address unanswered questions concerning endocrine homeostasis in critically ill children. His most recent work has focused on investigation of the value of controlling blood sugar levels in critically ill children. Dr. Agus co-led the team, along with Dr. Vinay Nadkarni at CHOP, to complete HALF-PINT, a thirty-two-center randomized controlled trial of tight glucose control in medical-surgical (non-cardiac) patients in pediatric ICUs across the US and Canada. They sought to determine whether close management of blood sugar in a sick child will enhance and hasten recovery. The results were published in the New England Journal of Medicine ( NEJM ), and summarized by the United Kingdom’s National Institute for Health Research ( NIHR ).
